title: Valia
about:
Valia at Dubai Creek Harbour is a residential complex developed by Emaar Properties, offering 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments next to Dubai Square Mall. The project is designed for comfortable daily living, with access to a swimming pool, gym, kids’ play area, and community park.

Valia by Emaar Properties combines practical apartment layouts, family-friendly amenities, and a prominent position within a growing waterfront community. Buyers can secure a residence with a 10% down payment, while its location beside Dubai Square Mall and Emaar’s established reputation support strong capital appreciation.

characteristics_module.description:
• Location - Positioned close to Dubai Square Mall and Emaar Properties Metro Station, Valia offers convenient access to shopping, leisure and transport options.
  • Properties - A selection of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments supports varied household needs and investment preferences.

  • Developer - Developed by Emaar Properties, Valia benefits from the expertise of one of Dubai’s established master developers.
  • 10% Down Payment - Secure a Valia apartment with a convenient 10% initial payment and manage the remaining amount across scheduled instalments.
  • High Capital Appreciation - Dubai Creek Harbour’s growth, Emaar’s reputation, and diverse unit types strengthen Valia’s prospects for long-term capital appreciation.

location_tile.title: Perfectly Placed Beside Dubai Square Mall
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Located beside the upcoming Dubai Square Mall and set to benefit from the future Dubai Metro Blue Line, Valia enjoys a well-connected address in Dubai Creek Harbour. Residents can reach key areas across Dubai with ease while living within one of the city’s most sought-after waterfront communities.

The development is close to Creek Marina, a vibrant destination for yachting, waterfront dining and leisurely walks along the promenade. Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is also nearby, offering views of protected wetlands and thousands of migratory birds, including its famous flamingos.
